limitations: Read-only semantic source review, not implementation or hostile validation.
Provider key/index/collation and DTO/plugin native behavior require later actual binding; lexical matches alone do not establish a defect.
RequirementsController is excluded here and reviewed by owner007. Other14root build/doc candidates were reassigned to agent005 before full read.
findings: Preserve mixed operational IDs and authored soft references in handoff/HV/triage/session models.
Preserve typed ordered composite references, optional-null relationships, standalone numeric contracts, Global/Workspace distinctions, append-only history and project-versus-local-workspace identity.
Effective model includes shadow columns, workspace conversions and explicit requiredness that cannot be inferred from CLR annotations alone.

processFriction.observation: Early Task004 design/mock gap discovery is the Unit-of-Work process doing its job before gaps become difficult to fill.

entries.observation: RunId, replay identity, leases, state version and extraction metadata are operational. CreatedTodoId and TodoCreationIntentId are soft TODO references; normalized DraftJson can contain authored references.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve operational values and historical draft bytes; resolve newly versioned TODO references through project/origin/kind and typed aliases without casting. Include replay and approval recovery paths in later bindings.

entries.observation: LinkId is a long operational row key and RequestId points to a review request. ArtifactType selects a heterogeneous locator: TODO, requirement, session, triage, plan, file, commit or document.
entries.b4Effect: Do not allocate every locator as a project record. Preserve file paths and Git SHAs; only typed authored target kinds use canonical project mappings. Validate declared 1024 locator length without truncating.

entries.observation: DiagnosticId is an operational long row key; RequestId is its review parent. Code and Message are diagnostic payload, not authored entity identity.
entries.b4Effect: Retain row/request linkage and current limits. Explicit snapshot publication must preserve source values rather than treating every numeric diagnostic key as a canonical allocator input.

entries.observation: ExecutionId and RequestId identify reviewer execution and its request. InputTokens and OutputTokens are nullable usage counts, not identities.
entries.b4Effect: Retain execution/request identities, nullable counts and provenance; no tag allocation or numeric conversion is justified by these lexical hits.

entries.observation: FindingId and RequestId are operational. ArtifactId is a heterogeneous soft target and RequirementId can point to a requirement or AC.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve operational finding/request keys and evidence text. Versioned lookup of authored artifact/requirement/AC targets must carry exact target kind and project scope, including legacy aliases and maximum lengths.

entries.observation: RequestId is an operational review identity with child links, executions, findings and diagnostics. HttpStatus and quality values are observations, not IDs.
entries.b4Effect: Keep request and children attributable; do not reinterpret status codes or request identifiers as authored sequences. Publication retains original identities and sanitized text.

entries.observation: EdgeRowId is a long surrogate; FromMemoryId and ToMemoryId are explicit directed memory references with edge type and weight.
entries.b4Effect: Workspace-authored edges use the approved canonical edge/parent mapping; Global edges retain original scope. Preserve directed endpoint order, exact typed aliases and edge uniqueness; do not convert the weight.

entries.observation: Id is a string key shared across scopes. Global rows have null WorkspaceId, Workspace rows carry a path; Category affects generated IDs and Version is a content counter.
entries.b4Effect: Split Global/control and Workspace-authored handling per classification. Preserve original text and versions; versioned Workspace IDs and category-aware family parsing must not change Global IDs or infer chronology across origins.

entries.observation: MemoryId is the parent lookup key; WorkspaceId is nullable for Global rows. ContentHash, embedding JSON and IndexedAtUtc are derived index state.
entries.b4Effect: Treat as derived/control per B2, not a new canonical authored allocation. A project index must resolve its canonical parent while preserving Global behavior and avoiding cross-store FK/join assumptions.

entries.observation: VersionRowId is a long row key, MemoryId a parent, and VersionNumber a contiguous content ordinal. Snapshot title/content are append-only history.
entries.b4Effect: Apply approved workspace version-row and parent mapping while preserving original row aliases, version ordinals and snapshot bytes. Global history remains outside automatic project rekeying.

entries.observation: ProductId is a host-global surrogate and Key is the explicit product key. OwnerWorkspaceId is a workspace reference; source explicitly forbids a workspace query filter.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve host-global product semantics and existing product key grammar. Do not allocate ProductId from a project tag merely because it is numeric; native separation must preserve owner/membership references.

entries.observation: ProductId plus WorkspaceId identifies membership; Role and AddedBy record the host-global association. There is no independent authored child ID.
entries.b4Effect: Retain composite membership identity and host-global owner/member semantics. Any federation projection requires explicit mappings, not invented per-membership canonical IDs or cross-store FK enforcement.

entries.observation: Id is a long surrogate; CriterionId is the public criterion string. Parent identity is ordered WorkspaceId, RequirementKind, RequirementId; Ordinal is display position.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved REQ-AC canonical identity with typed legacy surrogate/public aliases and canonical parent vector. Preserve satisfaction/evidence and named legacy criterion IDs; reorder never implies rekey or completion.

entries.observation: Layer Key is workspace-scoped, Order is the immutable comparison ordinal, and ScopeEndLayerKey is another layer reference.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve layer ordering separately from identity and use the approved project-scoped layer projection. Existing legacy lowercase key validation cannot be widened by blindly passing uppercase canonical IDs; no new family is invented by this review.

entries.observation: WorkspaceId plus caller IdempotencyKey identifies an operational recovery receipt; PayloadHash guards replay and ResultJson can contain requirement results.
entries.b4Effect: Retain idempotency keys and hashes exactly. Typed result references need versioned projection without rewriting existing recovery receipts or mistaking the caller key for a generated requirement ID.

entries.observation: WorkspaceId, FrId, TargetKind and TargetId form the association; SourceKind is fr, TargetKind tr/test. Both ends navigate to requirement rows.
entries.b4Effect: Map both canonical parents with explicit kinds and ordered composite columns; no independent invented link ID. Preserve standalone references and historical source IDs and refuse absent versioned capability before mutation.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogTurnId are operational numeric keys. Order is local action ordering; FilePath is a locator and Description is audit text.
entries.b4Effect: Keep source row and turn keys plus action order unchanged. Explicit published snapshots carry preserved operational graph/provenance; do not rewrite historical descriptions or file paths into canonical ID grammar.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogTurnId identify operational rows. Sha is an external Git hash, Branch and Author are external metadata; Ordinal is local ordering.
entries.b4Effect: Retain exact Git SHA/branch and audit values. Published snapshot mappings preserve parent/children without interpreting Git hashes or numeric ordinals as project authored IDs.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogCommitId are operational parent/child keys; Ordinal is commit-local position and Path is the changed-file locator.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve original typed keys, ordering and path in explicit session snapshot publication. No independent canonical allocation follows from a numeric row hit.

entries.observation: Operational identity includes long Id and unique WorkspaceId, SourceType, SessionId; AgentSessionId and transcript/executable paths retain provider provenance. Counts are statistics.
entries.b4Effect: Keep live sessions operational. Explicit SESSION-SNAPSHOT publication preserves original keys, agent identities, source fingerprints and child graph; do not conflate local workspace path with shared ProjectId or infer global order from Id.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogTurnId are operational keys; Ordinal orders dialog and Content preserves recorded processing text.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve complete dialog order/content and exact parent identity during explicit publication. Do not parse or rewrite arbitrary prose as canonical references.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogId are operational row/parent keys; Tag is a free string capped at256.
entries.b4Effect: Retain tags and source parent mappings. Historical tags can name requirements but are not normalized FKs; never claim a broad text rewrite is a safe identity migration.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogTurnId are operational keys. ContextItem accepts path, URL or reference and is capped at2048.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve locator text and ordering; where versioned projection resolves authored targets it needs explicit type/provenance rather than parsing all context strings as IDs.

entries.observation: Id, SessionLogId and RequestId are operational turn identity. TodoId is a soft authored reference with None sentinel; RawContextJson and OriginalEntryJson are historical bytes.
entries.b4Effect: Keep original turn/request keys and historical JSON; published snapshots retain typed source provenance. Resolve versioned TodoId explicitly without mutating historical audit text or replacing None with an ID.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogTurnId are operational keys. ListType chooses DesignDecision, Requirement, FileModified or Blocker; Value remains the original string.
entries.b4Effect: Retain ordered list values and exact parent mapping. A Requirement list item is not evidence of a normalized FK and does not authorize historical text rekeying.

entries.observation: Id and SessionLogTurnId are operational keys; Tag is a free string and the parent owns session scope.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve tags and exact operational parent graph for explicit snapshots. Numeric row IDs are not canonical authored allocations and ordering is not cross-node chronology.

entries.observation: AuditId is an auto-increment operational audit key; TodoId links an authored TODO; Version is per-TODO history. SnapshotJson and PreviousSnapshotJson are immutable historical content.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve original audit keys, versions and snapshot bytes under the approved history classification. Map canonical TODO references/provenance for federated history without claiming global AuditId order or rewriting source history.

entries.observation: Id is a long child key; WorkspaceId and SingletonId reference document metadata. Ordinal and Date describe archive grouping.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved completed-group identity and typed legacy alias; map metadata parent using ProjectId plus singleton discriminator, not a generated singleton ID. Preserve archive order/date.

entries.observation: Id is an archive item key and GroupId its long parent. ItemId is a soft completed TODO reference; Ordinal is local position.
entries.b4Effect: Map approved completed-item/group canonical identities and typed original keys. Preserve optional ItemId/null and resolve authored TODO targets explicitly; no ordinal-to-ID conversion.

entries.observation: WorkspaceId plus fixed SingletonId1 identifies metadata. Notes and CompletedGroups are NotMapped collections loaded from dependent rows; projection health timestamps/messages are operational.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved ProjectId plus singleton discriminator, never an allocator sequence for1. Preserve authored children while separating projection health/control fields; source NotMapped does not mean those child records may be omitted.

entries.observation: Id is a long note row key; WorkspaceId and SingletonId point to the metadata singleton. Ordinal orders the exact note Value.
entries.b4Effect: Map approved note identity and parent singleton projection with typed old row alias. Preserve Value and ordinal; no text parsing or hidden note deletion.

entries.observation: Id is a list-row key and WorkspaceId/TodoId its composite parent. ListType distinguishes free description/details from DependsOn and raw FR/TR strings; normalized joins live separately.
entries.b4Effect: Map approved list-row/parent identities. Canonical references in dependency/requirement list types need explicit typed mapping, while raw user strings remain preserved; do not treat every Value as a foreign key.

entries.observation: Id is a long implementation-subtask key; WorkspaceId/TodoId is parent identity. Ordinal orders Task text and Done is independent state.
entries.b4Effect: Map approved task-row and TODO canonical identities with typed aliases. Preserve ordinal/text/done exactly and never synthesize success from identity migration.

entries.observation: Id is an int surrogate. Owner, Repo, Branch and ManifestPath locate a GitHub tool bucket; Name is its configured natural key.
entries.b4Effect: Honor B2 registry classification and standalone numeric DTOs. Do not invent authored canonical families for external repository coordinates; any future project projection needs explicit versioned mapping and original provenance.

entries.observation: Id is an int surrogate. Name, command template, parameter schema, WorkspacePath and BucketName define a tool registration that may be Global or workspace-scoped.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve scope and exact tool/bucket/command semantics under B2. A numeric ID or StringLength hit does not make command text an authored identity; avoid unsupported automatic canonical rewrites.

entries.observation: Id and ToolDefinitionId are int registry row/parent keys; Tag is a lowercase discovery keyword.
entries.b4Effect: Retain standalone numeric contract and exact parent/tag uniqueness. A versioned registry projection, if included by classification, must map parent references explicitly rather than cast canonical IDs to int.

entries.observation: GroupId and GroupKey identify operational report aggregation; ReportCount is a count. CreatedTodoId is a soft BUG-TRIAGE TODO reference.
entries.b4Effect: Keep operational group fingerprint and count behavior. Only newly versioned authored backlog targets use the approved BUG-TRIAGE family and typed lookup; do not convert group keys or quiet deadlines.

entries.observation: ReportId/GroupId and idempotency/dedupe keys identify triage work. SessionId/TurnId retain operational provenance; CurrentTodoId is an authored soft reference.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve operational report/group/idempotency identity and evidence JSON. Versioned TODO lookup must carry project/kind/origin and typed legacy value; arbitrary error signatures/tags are not normalized FKs.

entries.observation: Id is a long child key, ReportId its operational parent. ListType and Ordinal retain affected paths, symbols, hints and tags.
entries.b4Effect: Keep ordered original list payloads and parent mapping. Do not allocate project authored IDs merely because a triage child has a numeric surrogate.

entries.observation: RunId and GroupId identify research attempts. Prompt, GroupJson, raw outputs/streams and ResponseJson preserve audit provenance; CreatedTodoId is authored target.
entries.b4Effect: Retain original operational audit bytes and mappings. New authored TODO lookup uses canonical family/typed alias; never rewrite raw model output or source logs to simulate identity adoption.

entries.observation: WorkspaceId, UseCaseId and ActorId form the join with IsPrimary. Both parents are numeric in the standalone model.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved ordered canonical UC/ACTOR parent references, no invented association allocator. Preserve IsPrimary and typed Int64 originals; versioned contracts must not cast canonical strings back to long.

entries.observation: UseCaseId is a long key. VersionNumber/Priority are content values; ProductKey is host-global membership and DiagramGraphJson is the saved artifact graph.
entries.b4Effect: Add canonical UC identity and typed legacy key while preserving standalone numeric wire and original diagrams/history. Product membership and graph-local node IDs need their own classifications, not implicit rekeying.

entries.observation: ExtensionPointId and UseCaseId are standalone Int64 row/parent keys; Name and Description are authored content.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved extension-point/UC canonical IDs and typed aliases. Preserve content and parent isolation with versioned DTOs; do not widen the existing numeric contract silently.

entries.observation: FlowId and UseCaseId are standalone long keys. SequenceNumber orders flows; FlowType is Basic/Alternative/Exception.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved flow and parent canonical identity, retain numeric sequence as content order. Reject mistyped/cross-project parents without treating sequence as global chronology.

entries.observation: LinkId/UseCaseId are long keys; FrId plus FrKind refers to a requirement, and LinkOrder is optional ordering.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved UC-FR-LINK identity and UC parent plus canonical FR/kind/project vector. Preserve legacy numeric/string aliases, LinkType/Notes and original ordering; no requirement kind inferred from node tag.

entries.observation: SpecialReqId and UseCaseId are standalone long identities; Priority is nullable content and RequirementText is free authored prose.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved special-requirement/UC identities and typed aliases. Preserve nullable priority and exact prose; no free-text requirement extraction or inferred linkage.

entries.observation: StepId and FlowId are long keys; ActorId is nullable. StepNumber orders steps and Action/SystemResponse/DataEntities are authored text.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved step/flow/actor canonical mappings preserving null optional actor and typed legacy aliases. Keep step order separate from identity and verify actual optional FK metadata in native binding.

entries.observation: Id is a long policy-list child; WorkspaceId is both tenancy discriminator and parent FK. Category/Ordinal choose policy list and Value holds SPDX/country/org/person data.
entries.b4Effect: Use approved PROJECT-BANNED child identity and ProjectId parent projection while preserving local workspace path and exact policy values/order. Do not reinterpret SPDX tokens as generated IDs.

entries.observation: WorkspaceId/WorkspacePath are host-local normalized registration identities, including the empty Global row. CurrentRequirementLayerKey is a policy-layer reference; paths, RunAs and health/config fields are local.
entries.b4Effect: Keep physical workspace identity distinct from stable ProjectId. Partition authored policy from host registration/control; preserve Global row, local paths and soft-delete provenance, and resolve current-layer references through the approved projection.

entries.observation: All mapped entities, composite PK/FKs, max lengths, query filters, shadow soft-delete columns, generated values, audit snapshots and workspace stamping are configured here. WorkspaceKeyConversion runs at the end; MemoryIndex Workspace FK is explicitly required despite nullable CLR text. BuildEntityKey formats primary key components and audit sanitizer redacts Key-named fields.
entries.b4Effect: B2/B4 binding must inspect effective provider model including shadow properties and actual FK nullability/key order. Preserve standalone providers/migrations, append-only histories and operational key provenance; implement project-content mappings without cross-store FK/join/distributed SQL. Existing lexical sanitization/path normalization is not a versioned canonical parser; do not reuse its formatted audit key as a lossless typed alias. Native collation/index/length/generated-key behavior remains unproved.

entries.observation: Functions normalize local filesystem identities, distinguish opaque workspace IDs, hash request/proxy identities with domain separators, and length-prefix request key components. HashLength64 is SHA256 encoding length, not authored identity capacity.
entries.b4Effect: Preserve path/opaque/request/proxy semantics and existing hash versions. Stable ProjectId is distinct from machine path and receipt hash. Do not substitute case-insensitive proxy normalization or lexical workspace normalization for versioned canonical record parsing.

entries.observation: MCP tools declare long useCaseId/actorId/flowId/stepId and nullable actorId, dispatch typed CQRS requests, serialize numeric current DTOs, and pass FR string references. Int priorities/sequence/order are content. Errors map NotFound/Validation/Conflict prefixes without ID parsing.
entries.b4Effect: Retain existing standalone numeric tool schemas. Expose additive versioned canonical-string adapters with explicit project/origin/kind/typed alias provenance and capability refusal before writes; do not alter long parameters or cast canonical strings. Apply to get/update/delete/actor/flow/step/link/diagram/approval/product and returned aggregates; later installed-plugin binding remains outside this mock gate.
